question:

solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) For ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/587fe986eafab8b8bafee210cbdc643b24f44eaee7873dd371e1b7bd0131a369.png] ' elements → Both the elements are flipped vertically.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1fa436be34e60dfa46991be69e8adc4b8787615e6681efc592e383e2036ba001.png]
